name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
summary: Kreldig Ungor still thinks Karnitol's belongings can be found. Up the same coast, by Ranazjar Isle, the Slitherblade naga hold a place among night elf ruins that lie at the bottom of the sea, and Kreldig reckons the satchel is most likely there.

sections.title: Ruins in the Deep
sections.body: Following the second part of the Karnitol shipwreck search, Kreldig Ungor tells you hope is not lost. Along the same coast but farther north, close to Ranazjar Isle, sunken night elf ruins lie on the ocean floor, and the Slitherblade naga call them home. Kreldig judges it the likeliest place for Karnitol's satchel. A Recovery Diver's Potion is provided.

sections.title: The Stronger Naga
sections.body: Kreldig figures a scouting party that came so far south had to be a strong one. So in looking for Karnitol's belongings, Kreldig would try the more powerful naga first, the tidehunters and the sea witches.

faq.q: Who asks you to find Karnitol's satchel?
Where does Kreldig think the belongings are?
faq.answer: Among the sunken night elf ruins north along the coast, near Ranazjar Isle, which the Slitherblade naga make their home.

faq.q: Which naga does Kreldig suggest searching first?
faq.answer: The tidehunters and sea witches, the stronger naga. Kreldig reasons that a scouting party that went so far south would have been powerful.
The second part of the Karnitol shipwreck search comes before this.
